doc.system_prompt:
# Hybrid Search Engine
Runs BM25 (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch), dense vector (your embedding store), and structured keyword filters in parallel, then fuses results with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) or learned weights. Tunable per-query: exact product codes go BM25-heavy, conceptual queries go vector-heavy. Recall@10 up 25-35% over vector-only.

## How it works
- Executes BM25, vector ANN, and metadata-filtered search in parallel against the three backends
- Fuses ranked lists with reciprocal rank fusion or a learned per-query weight model
- Detects query intent (exact-match vs conceptual) via regex + classifier and boosts the appropriate backend
- Returns unified hits with per-backend scores so the agent can explain 'matched on BM25 for SKU, vector for description'

## Use cases
- E-commerce: 'Sony WH-1000XM5' hits BM25 exact SKU + vector for 'noise cancelling headphones'
- Support bot: 'error E4021' hits BM25 exact code + vector for similar resolved tickets
- Legal research: case number exact + conceptual holdings across jurisdictions
